topics.name: Stutter at a steady frame rate
topics.about: Animation error, and the first cause of stutter: **delta time jitter**.

topics.name: Fixing delta time jitter
topics.about: The vsync timer: round each measured frame time to whole refreshes, so every frame shows the moment it is on screen.

topics.name: Stutter from late frames
topics.about: The second cause of stutter, **bad frame pacing**: frames that reach the screen late or unevenly, why missed frames have no easy fix, and the strategies for them, starting with adapting the rate to the frames.

topics.name: Beyond vsync: VRR and input latency
topics.about: What VRR changes, and how pacing meets input latency.

topics.name: Go further
topics.about: Why the average frame rate hides stutter, how to measure animation error, and where to read more.

topics.name: Appendix: staying within the frame budget
topics.about: Not pacing strategies, but ways to keep frames within their budget: render scale, dynamic resolution and better upscalers.
